benchmark_name: Curify Visual Search Benchmark - 326-query Easy Query regression set
source_repository: internal (not public) - Curify daily-report/evaluation working repository
source_commit: 64fee70 (query bank generation); commit set covering Curify frontend product repository under evaluation: production baseline sha c550856e07c2c7058f955799beb9738e7a9b4f0a (2026-07-21 capture), candidate branch baobao/search-relevance-prod-main-v2-r3-root-cause-fix-2026-07-19 at sha 0e794cd91396a96cd56fd1d8f7f1495909f3adc5 (2026-07-22 capture)
evaluation_commit: 2dc55f3 (evaluation-repo commit that recorded the 2026-07-22 run); amended in 8af3354
transformation_summary: queries.csv: query_id (V001-V326) taken from easy_query_v2_input_with_ids.csv, joined and cross-validated against easy_query_bank_v2_2026-07-16.csv by exact query text and row order (0 mismatches); query, language, scenario, category, reason columns copied verbatim. evaluations.csv: two evaluation runs stacked with a run_variant column - 'production_baseline_2026-07-21' (Curify production main, sha c550856e) from BASELINE_EASY326.csv, and 'candidate_2026-07-22_0e794cd9' (candidate branch baobao/search-relevance-prod-main-v2-r3-root-cause-fix-2026-07-19 at sha 0e794cd9) from 03_FULL326_LATEST_RESULTS.csv; both joined to query_id via row_index, cross-checked against query text (0 mismatches). Dropped operational columns not meaningful outside the source repo (elapsed_ms, used_rewrites, paths_used, collect_error). No query text, label values, or scores were altered in any file.
known_limitations: This benchmark evaluates Curify's own search system across two internal code states (a production baseline and a candidate branch); it is not a cross-platform comparison against Pinterest, Bing, Google, or Canva. No such cross-platform evaluation exists for these 326 queries in the source material.

The candidate branch evaluated (0e794cd9, 2026-07-22) was explicitly assessed by its own internal report as NEEDS_MORE_FIXES / not yet approved to replace production at the time of capture. Results should be read as a regression-testing snapshot, not a claim about current production Curify search quality.
relevance_label (PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL/UNJUDGABLE) and relevance_score are generated by an LLM judge (gpt-4o-mini, temperature 0, documented rubric - see METHODOLOGY.md), not by human reviewers.
Human-review data is not included in this public release. An internal human verification pass exists over this query set but has been withheld from publication.
zero_result / low_result flags are per-run (production_baseline vs candidate) and reflect result-count thresholds documented in METHODOLOGY.md, not a subjective quality judgment.
